capture.final_message:
Split the conjunction.

- For the first component, use the standard representation of a singleton image: membership in \(f''\{a\}\) is equivalent to being \(f(a)\). Set extensionality reduces the equality to this elementary equivalence.

- For the analytic component, pass through Chebyshev’s second function:
  \[
  \theta(x)\le \psi(x)\le (\log 4)x.
  \]
  The first inequality follows because \(\psi\) includes all prime-power contributions, including every prime contribution counted by \(\theta\), with nonnegative logarithmic weights. The second is the standard Chebyshev bound available from the imported Chebyshev/prime-counting theory; its required hypothesis is precisely \(0\le x\).

Finish by transitivity, with only minor normalization if the library states the product as \(x\log 4\) instead of \((\log 4)x\).
